verify.note: Measures the consequence in two halves, both mutation-tested. The behavioural half IMPORTS lib/ui/modal-stack.ts and runs it: a push publishes that the page is covered, the innermost modal is the topmost one, an inner close does not report a clear page while the outer is still up, the last close publishes the clear, and a pop for an id that is not on the stack notifies nobody. The wiring half reads the two files with comments stripped and fails if the ticker stops folding the modal latch into `paused`, if the interval stops gating on `paused`, or if the Dialog goes back to a private stack, stops publishing, or stops releasing the scroll lock at depth zero. A probe cannot import a .tsx, so the rendered consequence belongs to the suite: components/spaces/calendar-console-quiet.render.test.tsx watches the whole document for thirty seconds with the console open and fails at 5000ms without this fix, and components/layout/dispatch-ticker.render.test.tsx pins the same thing on the bar alone plus its control and the refuted height theory.
